title: Optional hygiene: firmware/bridge-zephyr/subsys/lichen is a frozen reference snapshot drifting from the live module
description: Residual from project-LICHEN-worker6-1tpy (P4, optional). firmware/bridge-zephyr carries a vendored copy of the L2 sources (subsys/lichen/lichen_l2.c, lora_l2.c, crash_info.c, lichen_util.c, ipv6_addr.c + headers) that is NOT compiled - bridge-zephyr/CMakeLists.txt target_sources is only src/main.c, includes come from the live lichen module (1www.61 resolved the earlier not-compiled enforcement question). The snapshot already drifted (its lichen_l2.c predates jfzk's LICHEN_ESCHC/ENOKEY/crash_info-classification changes and qn87/5rvk-era schc changes it references). Risk is low (nothing compiles it; resurrecting it would require deliberately re-adding sources to the build), but if the snapshot is meant as a fallback/reference it should either be periodically re-synced from lichen/subsys/lichen/l2 or deleted per the 1www.61 direction. Decide ownership: either add a periodic sync step, delete the snapshot, or document it as intentionally frozen. No action taken in 1tpy per the workspace leave-alone default.
